source.name: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS), national industry-specific estimates

method: For each NAICS sector, 3-digit and 4-digit industry, the top 40 detailed SOC occupations by PCT_TOTAL (percent of the industry's total employment, as published by BLS), mapped to the O*NET-SOC code in this repo (".00" code when it exists; other_onet_codes lists the remaining codes sharing the SOC). Suppressed BLS cells ("**", "*") are null and those occupations are skipped. Cross-industry national data; it describes a typical employer in the industry, not any specific one.
